name: mage-os/workflows-inventory
description: Mage-OS Workflow Engine inventory domain pack: the stock-threshold-crossed trigger + detector, the stock-flag hysteresis table, and the product.set_stock action

suggest.mage-os/workflows-triggers-core: Publishes inventory.stock_threshold_crossed and inventory.back_in_stock as real async events via EventPublisher; without it, StockThresholdDetector only logs a debug message
suggest.magento/module-inventory-api: Enables MSI source-aware stock updates via product.set_stock source_code
suggest.magento/module-inventory-sales-api: Enables the MSI-aware salable_qty product stock condition (GetProductSalableQtyInterface); without it, salable_qty is absent and matches negative operators only
suggest.magento/module-inventory-catalog-api: Resolves the default MSI stock id for the salable_qty product stock condition (DefaultStockProviderInterface)
